title: Mauryan decline: more rulers, threats, successors

boxes.title: Later Mauryas & the coup
items: Empire probably split in two after Ashoka

boxes.title: More causes
items: **Great Wall of China** (c. **220 BC**) pushed Scythian tribes towards India
Revolts at Taxila under **Bindusara** and Ashoka against wicked officials
Debate: Ashoka-blame thesis vs structural causes

boxes.title: Significance
items: End of ==first pan-Indian empire== → regional kingdoms + Brahmanical revival
Andhra feudatories declared independence → Satavahanas ruled Deccan & Andhra
